alt_text: A CSS matrix and ordered ranking list median similarity for canonical cohort pairs with pair counts, component coverage, quality, and distance.
interpretation: Higher persisted CSS indicates greater similarity under the unchanged raw-pairwise formula; descriptive return-toward-Mall direction remains a separate contract.
limitations: Wearables estimate physiologic, autonomic, MSK, movement, impact, and transport burden. Results are N-of-1 evidence, not clinical proof, diagnosis, causation, universal proof, or legal proof.
